messages:
lina: quick sync 1: prototype for a "evict bundle" that groups multiple prefix ops into one compressed apply per-node. intended to cut the O(N) broadcast storm we see on tenant drains. sharing preliminary shape before an RFC.

todd: high level soundbite?

lina: instead of sending a demote RPC per-prefix we send a bundle (bundle_id, epoch, ops[]). node applies local CAS per-op and reports back a small ack blob. reduces RPC count and lets us retry only failing ops.

jess: failure modes? i'm worried about partial applies and read staleness.

lina: plan: ops include expected_version + owner_epoch. apply = CAS on expected_version and ownership check. if mismatch node marks op failed. coordinator keeps bundle state and can emit retries or compensating ops. readpath will check a pending_bundle_set and consult owner if needed during quick epoch transitions.

omar: ops/console needs: view bundle progress, pause/abort, per-prefix failure reason. also config caps: max_bundle_size and per-cluster bundle rate.

dev-bot: infra-note: large bundles can spike RPC; recommend default bundle_size_cap=400 and bundle_rate=120/hr for hosted.

todd: example snippet?

lina: short example pasted:```{ "bundle_id":"b-1789999991","epoch":4096,"ops":[{"prefix":"acct/77/p1","op":"demote","ver":9},{"prefix":"acct/77/p2","op":"evict","ver":2} ] }```

jess: testing: i'll add chaos tests for partial apply + owner transfer. verify eventual convergence after retries.

lina: excellent. next step ill wire a small staging run with canary bundles and share metrics (RPC delta, partial-rate, retry-count). will follow up with RFC draft.

other: +1 to pairing on tests.

lina: thanks all :thumbsup:
